# Vendored zstd (full library: decoder + encoder)

- Upstream: Zstandard 1.5.7, https://github.com/facebook/zstd/releases/tag/v1.5.7, `zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz`, SHA-256
  `eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3` (matches the release's `.sha256`), retrieved
  2026-10-03.
- Licence: dual BSD-3-Clause or GPLv2; FultaArc uses it under the BSD licence (`LICENSE`, the release's `LICENSE`).
  Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
- Files: `zstd.c`, the release's own **full** single-file amalgamation (compress + decompress + dictBuilder),
  generated by `build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_library.sh` (`combine.py -r ../../lib -x
  legacy/zstd_legacy.h -o zstd.c zstd-in.c`), not edited, SHA-256
  `208e110a1f052d007242d4eef6ed20a03ab1dc6e13eb2c4ff8d158112120ba8e`; `zstd.h` and `zstd_errors.h` from `lib/`,
  unchanged, for the API. Built single-threaded (no `ZSTD_MULTITHREAD`), `-DZSTD_NO_TRACE`.
- Replaces the earlier decoder-only `zstddeclib.c` (removed 2026-10-11): the writer now needs `ZSTD_compress` for
  ZIP method 93 as well as the decoder path.
- Used for ZIP method 93 (read: `src/codec/codecs.c` `fa_dec_zstd`; write: `src/write/write.c` `zip_encode_body`)
  and the 7z coder `04F71101` (read only). The decode window is limited by FultaArc's dictionary limit
  (`ZSTD_d_windowLogMax`); the encoder emits a raw zstd frame (no WinZip wrapper), level 1..9 mapped onto zstd
  levels capped at 19.
